alpha.desc: Regularization term added to matrix Mx for calculating the inverse. Default = 0.1

atlas_image.desc: The atlas image (or multimodal atlas images) assumed to be aligned to a common image domain.

atlas_segmentation_image.desc: The atlas segmentation images. For performing label fusion the number of specified segmentations should be identical to the number of atlas image sets.

beta.desc: Exponent for mapping intensity difference to the joint error. Default = 2.0

dimension.desc: This option forces the image to be treated as a specified-dimensional image. If not specified, the program tries to infer the dimensionality from the input image.

exclusion_image_label.desc: Specify a label for the exclusion region.

mask_image.desc: If a mask image is specified, fusion is only performed in the mask region.

patch_metric.desc: Metric to be used in determining the most similar neighborhood patch. Options include Pearson's correlation (PC) and mean squares (MSQ). Default = PC (Pearson correlation).

patch_radius.desc: Patch radius for similarity measures. Default: 2x2x2

retain_atlas_voting_images.desc: Retain atlas voting images. Default = false

retain_label_posterior_images.desc: Retain label posterior probability images. Requires atlas segmentations to be specified. Default = false

search_radius.desc: Search radius for similarity measures. Default = 3x3x3. One can also specify an image where the value at the voxel specifies the isotropic search radius at that voxel.

target_image.desc: The target image (or multimodal target images) assumed to be aligned to a common image domain.
